pairs.claim: - nextThoughtNeeded: True if you need more thinking, even if at what seemed like the end

schema.description: Whether another thought step is needed

pairs.claim: - thoughtNumber: Current number in sequence (can go beyond initial total if needed)

schema.description: Current thought number (numeric value, e.g., 1, 2, 3)

pairs.claim: - totalThoughts: Current estimate of thoughts needed (can be adjusted up/down)

schema.description: Estimated total thoughts needed (numeric value, e.g., 5, 10)

pairs.claim: - isRevision: A boolean indicating if this thought revises previous thinking

schema.description: Whether this revises previous thinking

pairs.claim: - revisesThought: If is_revision is true, which thought number is being reconsidered

schema.description: Which thought is being reconsidered

pairs.claim: - branchFromThought: If branching, which thought number is the branching point

schema.description: Branching point thought number

pairs.claim: - branchId: Identifier for the current branch (if any)

schema.description: Branch identifier

pairs.claim: - needsMoreThoughts: If reaching end but realizing more thoughts needed

schema.description: If more thoughts are needed

pairs.claim: - synthesisId: Unique identifier for this synthesis session

schema.description: Unique identifier for this synthesis session

pairs.claim: - sourcePaths: Array of path/thought chain identifiers being synthesized (e.g., ["sequential_chain_1", "path_a", "path_b"])

schema.description: Array of path/chain identifiers being synthesized

pairs.claim: - convergencePoints: Key insights or conclusions that multiple paths agree on

schema.description: Key insights where multiple paths agree

pairs.claim: - contradictions: Points where reasoning paths conflict or disagree

schema.description: Points where reasoning paths conflict

pairs.claim: - evidenceWeighting: Assessment of which paths provide stronger evidence (e.g., {"path_a": "strong", "path_b": "moderate"})

schema.description: Assessment of evidence strength per path

pairs.claim: - resolutionStrategy: How contradictions are being resolved ("evidence_based", "logical_priority", "contextual_fit")

schema.description: How contradictions are resolved

pairs.claim: - synthesizedConclusion: The unified final answer or conclusion

schema.description: The unified final answer or conclusion

pairs.claim: - confidenceLevel: Confidence in the synthesized conclusion ("high", "moderate", "low")

schema.description: Confidence in the synthesized conclusion

pairs.claim: - traceability: Mapping of conclusion elements back to source paths

schema.description: Mapping of conclusion elements to source paths

pairs.claim: - openQuestions: Any remaining uncertainties or areas needing further exploration

schema.description: Remaining uncertainties or areas needing exploration

pairs.claim: - pathId: Identifier for the current reasoning path (e.g., "approach_a", "strategy_1")

schema.description: Identifier for the current reasoning path

pairs.claim: - thought: Current thinking step within this path

schema.description: Current thinking step within this path

pairs.claim: - pathNumber: Current path number in sequence

schema.description: Current path number

pairs.claim: - totalPaths: Total number of paths being explored

schema.description: Total number of paths being explored

pairs.claim: - thoughtInPath: Which thought number within this specific path

schema.description: Thought number within this specific path

pairs.claim: - pathStatus: Status of this path ("active", "completed", "abandoned", "merged")

schema.description: Status of this path

pairs.claim: - relatedPaths: Other path IDs that relate to or conflict with this one

schema.description: Related or conflicting path IDs

pairs.claim: - convergenceDetected: Whether this path is converging with others

schema.description: Whether converging with other paths

pairs.claim: - needsNewPath: Whether a new parallel path should be created

schema.description: Whether to create a new parallel path

pairs.claim: - readyForSynthesis: Whether all paths are ready to be synthesized into a final answer

schema.description: Whether ready to synthesize all paths

missing_claims: the qualifier that it applies even at what seemed like the end
that it can go beyond the initial total if needed
that it can be adjusted up or down
the condition that this applies if is_revision is true
the framing of which thought number is being reconsidered as conditional
the condition that this applies if branching
the qualifier 'if any' (i.e., branch may be absent)
the scenario of reaching the end but realizing more thoughts are needed
the example identifiers ("sequential_chain_1", "path_a", "path_b")
that entries can be thought chain identifiers as well as path identifiers
that the insights are conclusions (not just insights)
that points can reflect disagreement as well as conflict
the structured detail of a conflict point and its conflicting paths
the example weighting object ({"path_a": "strong", "path_b": "moderate"})
the available strength values strong/moderate/weak as the assessment scale
that the listed strategies are the full set of allowed values, excluding consensus
the quoted enumeration format of the three strategies
the allowed values high/moderate/low
that traceability maps conclusion elements specifically back to source paths (directionality)
that the areas are ones needing further exploration
the example path identifiers ("approach_a", "strategy_1")
that the path number is in sequence
the allowed values active/completed/abandoned/merged
that related paths can relate to or conflict with this one (both relation and conflict)
that these are other path IDs
the 'others' scope (converging with other paths)
the 'should' recommendation framing for creating a new parallel path
that all paths are ready to be synthesized into a final answer (the final-answer outcome)
